votes.motion: Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to close the staff meeting and go into the public meeting

Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Ferguson, moved to waive the storm drain impact fee only on Application #30478

Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the resolution approving a contract between the Magna Metro Township and KMH Consulting LLC for certain legislative lobbying work for the 2019 Utah State Legislative Session

Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the resolution approving the second amended contract between the Magna Metro Township and Government Consultants LLC for municipal administration services, with an amendment to the second page of the attachment under Item D, which should say the billable services shall not exceed $42,000, instead of the $36,000
Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to approve the appointments
Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to approve the appointments
